title: Agent Canonical Interface
description: Canonical intermediate representation for cross-framework agent infrastructure interop. v2 (2026-08-10, durable-canonical-agent-format plan) adds typed capabilities, typed handoffs, skills, MCP servers, invariant cores, references, and framework_extensions; schema_version is runtime-checked, not write-only. The framework enum is registry-derived (agentteams/frameworks/registry.py FRAMEWORK_IDS) plus the 'canonical' pseudo-framework; tests/test_framework_enum_consistency.py pins parity.

schema_version.description: Runtime-checked. v1 bundles ('1.0') were never persisted as a durable source; the bump makes any old-shape document fail loudly rather than degrade silently.

source_framework.description: Registry-derived (FRAMEWORK_IDS) plus 'canonical' for durable canonical directories loaded via load_canonical(). 'codex' registered as a thin prep-scoped target (durable-canonical-agent-format plan step F.4).

capabilities.description: Typed capability capture (v2). tool_scopes uses the canonical 7-token vocabulary matching claude.py's _VSCODE_TO_CLAUDE_TOOLS keys; model_hint is an advisory model string; raw preserves the source framework's original capability strings for frameworks with no canonical mapping (copilot-cli, agents-md) or for lossless round trips.

raw.description: Per-framework original capability declarations: {<framework>: <original string or structure>}. Escape hatch; never silently dropped.

handoffs.description: Typed handoff edges (v2). Captured via frameworks/base.py::extract_handoffs on export; applied on import per each adapter's handoff_delivery_mode().

invariant_core_markdown.description: The fenced AGENTTEAMS:BEGIN invariant_core span captured verbatim from the agent body (fences.py::_extract_fenced_regions); re-emitted as a properly fenced section on import.

raw_front_matter.description: Passthrough for framework-specific front-matter keys not modeled explicitly (keeps v1's additionalProperties:true round-trip tolerance).

skills.description: Team-level skill documents (v2). On export, walked from the source framework's skill dir (today: Claude's skills/<slug>/SKILL.md); on import, rendered via FrameworkAdapter.render_skill_file().

files.description: Co-located supporting files within the skill directory (excluding SKILL.md itself).

mcp_servers.description: Framework-neutral MCP server definitions (v2), folded in via mcp-server.schema.json. The schema's allOf security_review hard gates are re-validated on canonical import, not just at original authoring time.

references.description: Non-agent reference content discovered under the source team (e.g. references/** docs), carried so a canonical round trip does not silently drop them.

framework_extensions.description: Project-level, framework-owned configuration that has no cross-framework equivalent, keyed by framework id. Reuses the team-manifest.schema.json precedent for recipe_parameters/recipe_response/recipe_retry ('Goose-only; ignored by other frameworks'). Goose recipe configuration (parameters, response schema, retry policy, non-MCP extensions) lives under 'goose' so a goose round trip does not silently drop it.
